title: Purportedly AI-Generated Video Reportedly Depicted Kosovo LDK Figure Hykmete Bajrami and Former Serbian List Leader Goran Rakiq Walking Hand in Hand

behaviors.text: A purported AI-generated video is reported to have circulated on Facebook showing LDK parliamentary group chair a person and former Serbian List leader a person walking hand in hand.
In addition to the video reportedly being generated by AI, its audio was purportedly stitched together from separate parts of Bajrami's Debat Plus interview.
